title: Evaluating the Limits of Large Language Models in Multilingual Legal Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance and adversarial robustness across 15 different languages on legal and general-purpose benchmarks, and correlating these performance metrics with each language's syntactic similarity to English using tools like lang2vec and WALS to expose an Anglophone bias.

Analyzing confusion matrices in a legal fairness classification task (Online Terms of Service dataset) to measure the models' tendency to avoid critical or accusatory labels, disproportionately predicting 'clearly fair' or 'neutral' over 'clearly unfair' clauses.
